# streamtime_package_rule (Resource)

A rule that decides which versions of a repository are supported and which is the default. Managing the catalog needs the catalog permission, normally held by the root organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "streamtime_package_rule" "kafka" {
  name               = "kafka-3x"
  repository         = "kafka"
  version_constraint = ">=3.6.0 <4.0.0"
  target_status      = "supported"
  default_version    = "3.8.0"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A name for the rule. It is also the ID you use to import it. Changing it creates a new rule.
- `repository` (String) The repository the rule applies to.

### Optional

- `allowed_registries` (List of String) The registries matching versions may come from.
- `default_version` (String) The version offered by default.
- `description` (String) What the rule is for.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is applied.
- `max_age_days` (Number) Only versions published in the last this many days match.
- `preferred_registry` (String) The registry to pull matching versions from.
- `priority` (Number) Which rule wins when more than one matches. A higher number wins.
- `registry_url` (String) Limits the rule to one registry.
- `target_status` (String) The status matching versions get: active, supported, deprecated, latest or preview.
- `unmatch_status` (String) The status versions that do not match get: active, supported, deprecated, latest or preview.
- `version_constraint` (String) Versions the rule matches, for example >=3.6.0 <4.0.0.
- `version_list` (List of String) Exact versions the rule matches.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the package rule. Use it to import an existing one.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the rule's name.
terraform import streamtime_package_rule.kafka kafka-3x
```
